verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only self-hosted connectors running on your own infrastructure: Snyk Broker, the Container Registry Agent and the API/web Scanning Agent, deployable via Docker or Kubernetes. Each of these relays data to the Snyk service, and results are viewed in the Snyk portal. The local CLI and MCP server are client-side tools that call Snyk's hosted platform. Nothing in the pack shows the core scanning and analysis platform itself can be self-hosted or run on-premises.
